queue.title: Compiler ICE importing packages with local types inside generic functions
queue.detail: logos.reachableFuncFactObjects and the overlay-clone scope walks iterated pkg.Scope().Names() skipping only dotted names. Lazily-imported scopes also carry hoisted local types with vargen names (T·N); forcing their lookup reaches object dicts with implicit type parameters that the simplified importer cannot materialize: base.Fatalf "unexpected object with N implicit type parameter(s)". Any Go package with a local type inside a generic func (e.g. creachadair/mds slice.LCSFunc seq) made dependents uncompilable: go build, go vet, logos lint, gglint all ICE'd.
queue.fix: Added importedDeclNames() filtering vargen-suffixed (T·N) and dotted (T.M) names via types.SplitVargenSuffix, applied to all four imported-scope iterations in optfacts.go — matching gcimporter's promoted-name filters.
queue.test: src/cmd/go/testdata/script/logos_import_hoisted_local_type.txt reproduces the ICE on the unfixed compile and passes fixed.
queue.found_via: dogfooding corpus: gglint/logos lint rc=3 on tailscale (transitively imports creachadair/mds/mdiff)
